subject: Post-demo: Monthly burn check + procurement routing and legal contacts
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@brightbridgehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap — usage band, target $/1M, procurement flags

Sarah / Tom — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of what you shared
- Expected steady-state usage: ~1.0M — 3.0M tokens / month (mostly text generation + embeddings for ranking).
- Pilot plan: 3-month pilot with ramp in month 2.
- Primary success metric: per-response latency < 300ms for single-turn generation and predictable cost of goods for feature rollout.

Pricing / budget signals we discussed
- Target unit economics: your finance team indicated a target of roughly $18 — $24 per 1M tokens (ballpark).
- That implies a monthly spend band of ~ $18k — $72k given 1–3M tokens.
- Procurement note: you mentioned PO-driven billing for anything above your standard vendor threshold (~$25k / month).

Immediate next steps (owner)
1) I’ll send a concise pricing estimate and SOW draft for the 3-month pilot (attached). — Jordan (today)
2) Sarah / Tom: confirm whether the procurement threshold is $25k / month (PO required) or a quarterly/annual threshold. — Sarah
3) Monica: can you add a 3-month ramp model and a suggested invoice cadence (monthly vs. net-30/60) to the estimate? — Monica

Attachments: pricing_estimate_v3.pdf (pricing table + example token breakdown), rb_sow_outline.docx (pilot scope + success criteria).

If the numbers look directionally right I’ll also include a short-line canary rollback + SLA note so legal can evaluate quickly.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lee <sarah@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — usage band, target $/1M, procurement flags

Jordan — thanks for the clear write-up and attachments. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Volume: 1.0M—3.0M/month aligns with our internal forecast for Q3; month-1 will be lighter (approx 0.8M).
2) Unit economics: our finance folks were thinking closer to $20 per 1M tokens as an internal target, but we are flexible for a pilot if you can show ramp protections.
3) Procurement threshold: confirmed — any recurring spend that goes over $25k / month requires a PO and our procurement director’s sign-off (Tom CC’d). For one-off professional services we can do exceptions, but billing must be clearly labeled.
4) Invoice cadence: preference is monthly billing, Net-30. We can consider Net-60 for the pilot only if there’s a PO in place.

Action on our side: I’ll introduce our procurement contact formally once we have a draft SOW and the pilot quote includes invoice/PO language. Please include a contact for legal review so we can parallelize.

Appreciate it — Sarah
Sarah Lee
Director, Product Operations — BrightBridge Health
sarah@brightbridgehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0144

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@brightbridgehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jun 2028 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — usage band, target $/1M, procurement flags

Thanks — that’s helpful. Two quick items I updated in the attached pricing_estimate_v3.pdf: 
- Added a conservative month-1 ramp line (0.8M tokens) and three ramp scenarios (slow/expected/fast) so finance can see sensitivity.
- Explicit note that recurring billing over $25k/month will be routed via PO (we’ll add a billing key on the invoice).

Legal / procurement contact for Redwood: 
- Primary: Legal Intake — legal@redwood.com (I’ll copy our solutions counsel when we’re ready).
- Billing: billing@redwood.com (for PO reference on invoices).

Proposed immediate timeline:
- By EOD today: I’ll upload the updated estimate + SOW draft to HubSpot (link below) and drop DocuSign-ready language for the pilot SOW.
- Early next week: Procurement intro (Sarah) → Tom + our billing/legal to confirm PO template and invoice cadence.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7654321
DocuSign (prelim): https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123

Jordan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jun 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: discount framing + approval path for >$25k PO requests

Internal note — Jordan / Monica, couple of items to lock before we send formal quote to procurement: 

1) Discount tiers (suggested for pilot):
   - No commit (pay-as-you-go): list price at $28 / 1M tokens (baseline).
   - Small pilot commit (3-month, 3M total commitment): 10% off list → ~$25.2 / 1M effective.
   - Mid commit (6-month, 12M total): 20% off list → ~$22.4 / 1M effective.

2) PO threshold handling: when spend > $25k/month we add billing@redwood.com + legal@redwood.com to any PO correspondence. For a pilot we can accept monthly Net-30 with PO; if they ask Net-60 push for PO as condition.

3) Ask finance to prepare a one-page ‘billing callout’ that we can paste into SOW — clarifies invoice name, remit address, and PO reference field. Monica, can you draft and attach to the SOW doc?

I’ll stand by to sign off on the pricing table after Monica drops the invoice cadence language.

— Karthik
VP, Sales Strategy — Redwood Inference
